text:
maria: Quick share — I profiled the KV cache during a 2h long-context replay and we’re seeing steady memory creep + slot fragmentation. heatmap attached (summarized below).
aj: Can you paste the top alloc stack or flame snippet?
maria: sure — the hot paths are: alloc_block -> buddy_alloc -> kv_insert_longctx. Flame: alloc churn at 60-70% during long tails.
chen: did you correlate with sequence length distro? If lots of mid-sized longctx we might be hitting wrong blocksize bins.
maria: yes, sequence histogram skewed toward 2048-4096. Our slab sizes are 1k/4k/16k, so many entries land in 4k but often use <3k causing internal fragmentation.
sam: interesting — have we tried dynamic blocksplit? e.g., split 4k into 2x2k when fragmentation metric exceeds threshold.
aj: sketch of an alternative: adaptive page sizing based on recent seq histogram + per-slab eviction pulse that prefers coalescing adjacent free ranges. Also a lightweight compaction trigger when free_run_ratio > 0.35 and avg_free_run_len < target.
maria: I ran a short canary with a prototype: enabled adaptive 4k->2k splits + a conservative compactor run every 5m. Results: mem usage down ~12% after 30m, fragmentation metric (frag_index) down 28%, but p50 token latency increased ~3% under 95th-percentile batching.
chen: 3% p50 spike could be from synchronous compaction. Is the compactor async?
maria: prototype compactor is synchronous on the allocator thread. I warned that would hurt tail.
aj: make it async and cooperative — let it yield to serving threads and only compact small windows at a time. Also consider KV cache hinting: mark high-reuse keys (prefixes) as pin candidates to avoid moving them.
sam: can we try a hybrid: prefer splits over compaction so we reduce copying. compaction only when fragmentation entropy passes a higher bar.
perf-bot: perf regression check for branch "kv/frag-split-proto": CI benchmarks show +1.2% throughput regression on tiny-batch microbench (95th) — flagged.
chen: that matches maria's local. We need to separate user-visible work from background maintenance. First step: make compactor async and throttled by CPU budget.
maria: agreed. I'll rework to cooperative compaction + heuristic: only compact ranges with >2 free holes and reclaimable_density > 0.5. Also add metrics: frag_index, avg_free_run_len, split_count, compaction_time_ms.
aj: also instrument kernel selection path: ensure kernels that touch long ctxs prefer smaller block allocations to reduce copy size. Might be a cross-team change but big win.
sam: one more thought — eviction policy: current LRU pushes many mid-size objects to tail causing holes. Could try size-aware eviction: evict large low-reuse chunks first to reduce fragmentation.
maria: plan: 1) make compactor async + add throttling, 2) enable adaptive 4k->2k split with cooldown, 3) rollout canary on dedicated pool, 4) collect new frag metrics and perf waterfall. Anyone want to pair on the async compactor changes?
aj: I can help tomorrow morning. pls post branch name.
chen: I'll add dashboards for frag_index and reclaimable_density.
sam: I'll draft canary checklist and SLA rollback criteria (:thumbsup:).
maria: branch: "kv/frag-adaptive-split-async-compactor". Pushed prototype w/ flag off by default.
perf-bot: noted. Job queued for canary perf run.
maria: thanks all — will update once async compactor patch is green and we have canary numbers.
